main.description: A lightweight 'is/not' review of something represented by another atproto record

subject.description: An atproto record that describes the thing that is being reviewed. Readers of these records can decide if the cid needs to be identical for their purposes, or if a weak ref to the at-uri is enough.

adjective.description: An adjective, in any language, that the subject either is, or is not.

direction.description: Whether the subject *is* the adjective (1), *is not* the adjective (-1) or, less commonly, *really* is (2), or *really* isn't (-2). A value of zero is an explicit 'no comment', uncertainty, or lack of opinion.
